knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Work outside training or authority is stopped and escalated. Hygiene requirements are followed, not worked around.
Contaminated clothing is changed and bagged safely, and soil is not carried to the next site. Carrying it home, wearing it on to the next site or leaving it in clean storage are not acceptable.
The lesson says to perform hand hygiene at task transitions, after handling waste and before touching clean supplies.

Eating near cleaning chemicals and contaminated areas is the unsafe alternative. The lesson says to keep eating, drinking and personal belongings away from them. Changing contaminated clothing, keeping belongings away from chemicals and covering a minor cut under site policy are safe.
Illness, symptoms or exposure are reported through the workplace procedure, and the worker does not diagnose or handle it privately.

practicalCriteria: Checks the site/task requirements before acting
Identifies and applies relevant safety and privacy controls
Communicates professionally and respects authorisation boundaries
Records the outcome and escalates unresolved issues correctly
passRule: All safety-critical criteria must be demonstrated; remediate and reassess any missed criterion.
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 4: Keep eating, drinking and personal belongings away from cleaning chemicals and contaminated areas.
Record of procedure step 7: Report illness, symptoms or exposure through workplace procedures rather than diagnosing yourself.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 1 is not done: Start work with clean clothing, clean hands, and hair and nails suitable for hygienic tasks.
